description: Set start_time and/or end_time (ISO with offset) on a campaign or ad squad. end_time must be in the future and after the start. A change that lets an ACTIVE item deliver sooner (an earlier start, or reviving an ended item) is checked and limited like enabling it. Previews unless confirm=true. For several items at once pass ids instead of the single id: Set start/end time on up to 20 campaigns or ad squads. Changes that let ACTIVE items deliver sooner are checked and limited like enabling them. Previews unless confirm=true. Use to change when one campaign or ad squad starts and ends. For several pass ids instead of id. For hours of the day use snap_set_ad_schedule.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

end_time.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD: the whole day is included, so it means the start of the next day in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET) or an ISO date-time on the hour with an offset, such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00+03:00 (Snap needs whole hours).

entity.description: What to act on: campaign, adsquad or ad (ad squads are Snapchat's ad sets).

id.description: Id of the item named by entity. Get it from snap_list_campaigns, snap_list_adsquads or snap_list_ads.

ids.description: Ids of the items to change, at most 20. Get them from the matching matching list tool.

start_time.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD: the start of that day in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET) or an ISO date-time on the hour with an offset, such as 2026-10-19T00:00:00+03:00 (Snap needs whole hours).

name: snap_set_schedule
